LanguageData.TSA_WD_Diplo_UnderdogIncidentSeverityToo: When underdog buff is active, strength removed by incidents is multiplied by this (e.g. 0.5 = half the loss).

LanguageData.TSA_WD_BuySettlement_GizmoDesc: Peacefully purchase this settlement with goods from your colony/warehouses and optional goodwill. A caravan delivers payment; on arrival you choose what to do with the tile (cannot leave empty, cannot gift back to the seller).
LanguageData.TSA_WD_BuySettlement_Disabled: Settlement buying is disabled in mod settings.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_BuySettlement_Pending: A purchase caravan is already en route to this settlement.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_BuySettlement_NoColony: You need a player colony map to pay with goods.

LanguageData.TSA_WD_BuySettlement_DealPriceTip: Pay with silver, goods or goodwill. Payment (goods and goodwill) is deducted immediately. A caravan will travel from the closest outpost or colony to the target. If the caravan is destroyed, payment is lost. If the settlement is destroyed or the deal becomes invalid (relation, seller settlements, or tier change), goods and goodwill are refunded. Overpayment is not refunded. Payment and overpayment strengthen the seller's nearby settlements (boost strength and can upgrade tiers).

LanguageData.TSA_WD_GiftSettlement_AbortLetterTextSet: The gift to {0} failed because the settlement no longer exists. The goods were returned.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_GiftSettlement_AbortLetterTextBad: The gift to {0} failed because you are no longer allied or neutral with the owner. The goods were returned.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_GiftSettlement_AbortLetterTextFac: The gift to {0} failed because the settlement changed owners. The goods were returned.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_SettlementCaravan_InterceptWarnin: Warning: If this caravan is intercepted, the attacker gains settlement strength from the value of the goods.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_SettlementCaravan_LootLetterBody: {0} intercepted your {1} caravan and seized {2} silver.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_SettlementCaravan_LootLetterRadiu: This strengthened their settlements within {0} tiles of the incident.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_SettlementCaravan_LootLetterNoTow: The goods were seized, but they had no settlements within {0} tiles to strengthen.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_SettlementCaravan_LootLetterNoEff: No settlements in range gained strength from the seized goods.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Bribe_SettlementGizmoDesc: Pay goods for a temporary ceasefire. This faction will not launch new World Domination raids at your colony or outposts for the chosen duration. Raids already on the road are not recalled.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Bribe_RaidGizmoDesc: Send a payment caravan to catch this raid. On delivery, that raid dissolves. Strength investment is centered on the raid's launch settlement.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Bribe_Disabled: Faction bribes are disabled in settings.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Bribe_Pending: A bribe caravan is already en route to this target.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Bribe_BadRelation: You must be hostile with this faction to bribe them.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Bribe_UnderAsk: Offer at least {0} silver-equivalent in goods.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Bribe_NoOrigin: No colony or warehouse can send the bribe caravan.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Bribe_SameTile: Cannot send a bribe from the same tile as the settlement.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Bribe_SpawnFailed: Failed to launch the bribe caravan.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Bribe_AssignToAskTip: Clears current goods offers, then assigns the most valuable non-starred items until the ask is met. The last row only takes as many items as needed. Starred items are skipped.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Bribe_ThreatWeighted: Threat in range {0}, faction total {1}, weighted ask base {2}
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Bribe_InFlightWarning: Already-dispatched raid caravans from this faction will still arrive. Bribe each of those caravans separately, or fight them.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Bribe_SettlementCompletedText: Your bribe reached {0} ({1}). New World Domination raids from this faction against your colony and outposts are blocked for {2} days. Strength investment {3} silver. Raids already on the road are not recalled.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Bribe_RaidCompletedText: Your bribe dissolved {0} ({1}). Strength investment near the launch site {2} silver.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Bribe_AbortText: The bribe to {0} could not be completed.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Bribe_AbortTextLost: The bribe caravan to {0} was destroyed. The goods were lost.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Bribe_AbortTextRefund: The bribe to {0} could not be completed. The goods were returned.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Bribe_AbortTextTargetGone: The bribe to {0} failed because the target no longer exists. The goods were returned.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Bribe_AbortTextBadRelation: The bribe to {0} failed because you are no longer hostile with the owner. The goods were returned.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Bribe_CeasefireExpiredText: Your bribe ceasefire with {0} has ended. They may launch new World Domination raids at your colony and outposts again.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Log_BribeSettlementCompleted: Bribe ceasefire with {1} via {0} for {2} days.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Log_Raid_SkippedBribeCeasefire: Raid skipped: bribe ceasefire still active with {0}.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Bribe_SettlementSilverPerStrTip: Flat rate for ceasefire bribes. Mid and Late escalation do not change this rate (threat can still rise as more towns enter attack range).
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Bribe_CaravanSilverPerStrEarlyTip: Used while Mid and Late escalation are inactive.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Bribe_CaravanSilverPerStrMidTip: Used during Mid escalation. Late overrides this when Late is active.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Bribe_EnableTip: When enabled, hostile WD settlements and ground raid caravans targeting you show a Bribe gizmo.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Bribe_DaysTip: How long new World Domination raids from that faction are blocked after a successful settlement bribe.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Bribe_DiscountTip: Price multiplier is (days / short days) times (1 minus this discount).
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Bribe_RaidAskFloorTip: Raid bribe ask uses the greater of current strength and this fraction of launch strength.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Bribe_InvestmentFractionTip: Fraction of payment value converted to nearby settlement strength on success (gift and buy use 100%). Intercept loot still invests the full seized value.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Bribe_CaravanInvestRadiusTip: Tiles from the raid launch settlement used when investing after a successful raid bribe.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Bribe_GoodwillBonusDivisorTip: On a successful bribe, goodwill gained is payment market value divided by this number. Bribes cannot be paid with goodwill. Higher values mean a weaker bonus. Gift goodwill uses 40.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Notify_BribeSettlementCompletedTo: Letter when a ceasefire bribe arrives. Reminds you that in-flight raids are not recalled.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Notify_BribeSettlementAbortedTool: Letter when a ceasefire bribe fails mid-route or becomes invalid (with refund when applicable).
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Notify_BribeRaidCompletedTooltip: Letter when a raid bribe arrives and dissolves that caravan.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Notify_BribeRaidAbortedTooltip: Letter when a raid bribe fails (target gone, lost race, invalid deal) with refund when applicable.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Notify_BribeLostInTransitTooltip: Letter when a bribe caravan is destroyed and payment is lost (separate from abort/refund cases).
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Notify_BribeCeasefireExpiredToolt: Letter when a faction's bribe ceasefire timer ends.
